canonical_project: Quantum Switch Tamasuk DMM-B data center (SPARK expansion)
owner: Quantum Switch Tamasuk (Tamasuk Holding / Quantum Switch)
notes: Tamasuk's official release states QST started a second data centre, also in the Dammam/SPARK area; project-finance coverage cites 9 MW for the second SPARK facility with expected commercial operation around mid-2023. DataCenterMap lists DMM-B as operational carrier-neutral in the Dammam market; QST LinkedIn reports Tier III Gold TCOS for QST DC2 Phase 1 in Dammam. Mapped to Buqayq because the SPARK campus sits in Buqayq governorate.
